prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Capture Your Pet in Bright Lighting", "Upload a clear front-facing photo in good lighting for the best 3D pet desktop rendering.", "Choose Pet Photo"]
1: ["Mastering Desktop Pet Controls", "Click and drag your pet anywhere on screen. Right-click to open quick actions or toggle visibility.", "Got It, Bring Pet to Desktop", "Try Pet Teleport"]
2: ["Welcome Back to Your Desktop Companion", "Sign in with your previous provider to restore existing pets and desktop preferences.", "Restore with Cloud Sync", "Need help finding a previous pet? Check cloud account email."]
3: ["Prepare Your Desktop Workspace", "Decorate your desktop background canvas with toys while your pet renders in the cloud.", "Proceed to Spawning"]
4: ["Choose Your Pet Creation Path", "Pick a ready-made companion for instant setup or craft a custom pet from your photos."]
5: ["Signing in ensures your pet stats, custom appearance, and memory persist across app restarts and updates."]
6: ["Official Pet Guardian Badge Unlocked!"]
7: ["Rendering Your Pet for Desktop Appearance", "Optimizing 3D textures and desktop transparency layers."]
8: ["Your Pet is Ready to Walk on Your Desktop!", "Your companion will float freely over your apps. Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to summon or hide them."]
9: ["Select Companion Type (Instant vs Custom)", "Preset pets load in under 10 seconds. Custom photo pets take about 2 minutes to generate."]
